تنتشقون (form VIII)
# تَنْتَشِقُونَ (tantašiqūna) /tan.ta.ʃi.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَشَقَ (intašaqa)
# تُنْتَشَقُونَ (tuntašaqūna) /tun.ta.ʃa.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَشَقَ (intašaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
